heading: Nā lawelawe e hiki i kēia pūnaewele ke hoʻohana
stateAsk: ʻAʻole i koho ʻia: e nīnau mua
withdrawAll: Hoʻihoʻi i nā koho a pau
changedAllow: Mālama ʻia: ua ʻae ʻia ʻo {service}.
changedDeny: Mālama ʻia: ʻaʻole i ʻae ʻia ʻo {service}.
withdrawn: Ua hoʻihoʻi ʻia nā koho a pau. E nīnau hou kēlā me kēia lawelawe.
serviceSends_google_analytics: Helu i nā kipa a me nā ʻaoʻao i heluhelu ʻia. Loaʻa iā Google kāu helu wahi IP a hiki iā ia ke kau i nā kuki.
serviceSends_youtube: Pāʻani i nā wikiō mai YouTube mai. Loaʻa iā Google kāu helu wahi IP a hiki iā ia ke kau i nā kuki.
serviceSends_vimeo: Pāʻani i nā wikiō mai Vimeo mai. Loaʻa iā Vimeo kāu helu wahi IP; noi kēia pūnaewele iā ia mai hahai iā ʻoe.
serviceSends_google_maps: Hōʻike i nā palapala ʻāina mai Google Maps mai. Loaʻa iā Google kāu helu wahi IP a hiki iā ia ke kau i nā kuki.
serviceSends_speech: Inā ʻaʻole hiki i kāu polokalamu kele pūnaewele ke hoʻomaopopo i ka ʻōlelo ma kāu mea hana, hele kou leo i kāna lawelawe leo (Google, Apple a i ʻole Microsoft).
serviceSends_github: Hōʻike i nā kāleka waihona a me nā ʻike ʻē aʻe mai GitHub mai. Loaʻa iā GitHub kāu helu wahi IP a hiki iā ia ke kau i nā kuki.
serviceSends_webstatus: Hōʻike i nā hōʻailona kākoʻo polokalamu kele Baseline mai webstatus.dev mai, he papahana na Google Chrome. Loaʻa iā Google kāu helu wahi IP.
serviceSends_aframe: Hoʻouka i ka waihona A-Frame mai aframe.io mai e hōʻike i nā kiʻi 3D. Loaʻa iā aframe.io kāu helu wahi IP.
serviceSends_embed: Hōʻike i ka ʻike mai {host} mai. Loaʻa iā {host} kāu helu wahi IP a hiki iā ia ke kau i nā kuki.
